scope: Finite release-only aircraft feature restoration after landing control retirement; not whole external-controller handover acceptance
finding: The prior version preserved an aircraft feature snapshot when a foreign flight lease blocked cleanup, but had no general finite aircraft-feature cleanup service. Old landing control could remain active while no owner later retried the restoration.
implementation: Exact landing control retires once, preserving another typed flight lease. A public two-field release [original six-field snapshot, original absolute deadline] is published with PENDING acknowledgement.

New owner-local feature release checks exact release/snapshot, original revision+1, inactive landing, owner tracker epoch and no competing flight/player/Zeus/external control before eligible MOVE/PATH restoration.

One coalesced chain per receipt/owner/tracker epoch has at most60 retries and the original60s window. Local EH and existing tracker may offer the same receipt without changing issuer, revision or deadline.
Expired deadline observation precedes worker-marker coalescing, so a lost delayed callback cannot keep a matching receipt visibly PENDING forever.
RELEASED or UNRESOLVED acknowledgements bind revision/issuer/deadline. Expiry logs once and preserves snapshot provenance and the work key; no timeout grants completion.
Original-pilot FSM release remains its separate actor-local bounded service. Immediate native flight handback also refuses protected pilot tasks. Deferred callbacks issue no old flight/task commands.
bounds: No new world query or permanent worker. Reuses0.5s tracker/Local EH offers; coalesces one finite1s callback chain. Actual multi-aircraft/frame overhead remains unmeasured.
remaining: Actual blocked-controller release, shutdown, late public replication and rapid locality return need engine evidence.
External integrations must sequence relinquishment/acknowledgement before claiming native features; complete required external controller adapters are not proven.
Deferred callbacks intentionally do not restore flight-layer parameters or issue land/height/velocity/waypoint commands. Successor controllers must establish their own flight policy.
Expired UNRESOLVED provenance is retained; no automatic new deadline or operator retry/reset workflow was added.
Same-value mission feature edits remain indistinguishable; false physical/performance acceptance is prohibited.
Queue HOLD/READY/native dependency movement and the full production goal remain incomplete. Audits paused; all65families partial.
